description: Discord message operations. Actions: send, edit, delete, pin, unpin, react, bulk_delete, list.

action.description: Action: send, edit, delete, pin, unpin, react, bulk_delete, list.

after.description: Fetch messages after this message ID (list action).

before.description: Fetch messages before this message ID (list action).

channel.description: Channel name or ID (required for all actions).

embed.description: Embed object: {title?, description?, color? (int), fields?: [{name, value, inline?}], footer?: {text}, image?: {url}, thumbnail?: {url}}. (send/edit)

emoji.description: Emoji for react action. Unicode emoji or custom format "name:id".

guild_id.description: Guild ID for channel name resolution. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID env var.

limit.description: Max messages to fetch (list action, default 50, max 100).

message_ids.description: Array of message IDs for bulk_delete (2-100 messages, max 14 days old).

reply_to.description: Message ID to reply to (send only).

name: discord_message
